verdict.rationale: ByteAsk signs developers in with magic-link email instead of requiring an API key by default. Usage is tied to an account plan: a slash command shows the current plan and how much of each usage window is spent, payment upgrades the plan without re-signing in, and sessions renew themselves at launch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow, and detailed first-party documentation of the subscription tiers and their usage limits.
